notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!

The cats are ready, the building is nearly complete, and the wait is almost over!
We’re thrilled to announce that [b]A Building Full of Cats 2[/b] launches on [b]June 16th[/b].

It’s been quite the journey since our very first [b]Full of Cats[/b] game, and now—finally—our first full-fledged sequel is here. 
This sequel is so much more than an expansion with more floors. A LOT OF SURPURRISES awaits for you! ːwinkycatː
We can’t wait to hear what you think about it. ːfofinoː

Stay tuned, and don’t forget to wishlist it now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/

Thank you so much for these 3 years of love that made these series pawssible!
We wouldn't make it without your support! ːfofino2ː

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
